answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 4 epochs old, anchored at a tundra checkpoint. The fable chain is verified at intake and trellis publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 4 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The attacker spends 107 dollars and 19 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
